trajectory_data: Replay buffer samples fixed-horizon observation, action, reward, termination and optional task sequences; action dimensions are masked by task.
model_io: Encoder maps observations to latent z; dynamics(z,a)->z'; reward(z,a); termination(z); policy prior(z); ensemble Q(z,a).
action_and_neighbors: Action is concatenated before dynamics/reward. There is no graph-neighbor concept; continuous multitask action dimensions are padded and masked.
multi_step_objective: Recursive latent rollout with consistency, reward, termination and Q losses; each step weighted by rho^t.
planner: Policy-prior trajectories plus Gaussian samples, elite weighting, iterative mean/std updates, terminal Q; receding horizon.
uncertainty_ood_fallback: Multiple Q heads with min/average aggregation; no dynamics ensemble, support detector, or external safe-controller fallback.

reproduction_risk: medium: modern maintained code, but JAX-free PyTorch project and discrete graph actions differ materially.

planner: Execution samples the actor directly; imagination trains actor/critic offline from model states rather than enumerating candidates at each decision.

model_io: One Keras MLP per next-state factor; a causal adjacency row masks the state-action inputs for that factor.
action_and_neighbors: Traffic action is binary switch/stay; there is no multi-intersection neighbor action. Structural mask is learned/updated by causal discovery.
multi_step_objective: One-step factorwise MSE; model error becomes an exploration reward.
planner: Exploration policy seeks data useful for world-model learning; no deployment MPC.
uncertainty_ood_fallback: Prediction error/surprise guides exploration, not calibrated uncertainty or safe fallback.
data_leakage_check: Online discovery/training intertwines collection and model updates by design; not suitable as-is for fixed offline held-out evaluation.

reuse_boundary: No declared license and legacy Keras: design-only inspiration.

action_and_neighbors: Road relations route outgoing predictions to neighbor incoming lanes. Neighbor selected actions are not passed jointly into one environmental dynamics step.

planner: DQN/dueling DQN control, not model rollout planning.
uncertainty_ood_fallback: No ensemble/OOD/fallback in the inspected path.
